description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to serializing and handling in-memory message bodies for Orleans streaming, including serializer implementation, memory message body class, and associated serialization callbacks.

classes.name: DefaultMemoryMessageBodySerializer
classes.description: Default implementation of IMemoryMessageBodySerializer that uses Orleans.Serializer for serialization/deserialization, with support for runtime deserialization callback to resolve dependencies.

classes.name: MemoryMessageBody
classes.description: Represents the message body used in in-memory stream provider, containing events and request context.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a MemoryMessageBody object into an ArraySegment<byte>.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an ArraySegment<byte> into a MemoryMessageBody object.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Callback method invoked after deserialization to resolve dependencies from the service provider.

methods.name: MemoryMessageBody
methods.description: Constructor for creating a MemoryMessageBody with events and request context.
